name: Anti-HBs Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of Anti-HBs using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of hepatitis B surface antibody (Anti-HBs) in human serum, plasma and whole blood samples. The test can aid to monitor the recovery of patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV) and evaluate the efficacy of hepatitis B vaccine.
